data.narrative:
Fervo Energy is a Climate & Energy sector company at the IPO stage that has raised $1.5B+. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the broader Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set lacks sufficient depth for traditional comparable company analysis.

The peer-median method is not applicable. A search for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables within the Climate & Energy sector yielded zero datapoints meeting those criteria. While eight same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the minimum threshold of three comparable companies necessary to establish a reliable peer median. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, capital intensity, and commercialization timelines across Climate & Energy subsectors.

Without sufficient narrow-band comparable data, traditional triangulation cannot be completed. A defensible valuation range for Fervo Energy at IPO would require supplementary methods—such as discounted cash flow analysis anchored to geothermal asset economics, precedent transaction analysis in renewable energy infrastructure, or precedent IPO pricing within the sector—none of which are available in the provided dataset. The primary uncertainty remains the absence of recent, directly comparable transactions or public market reference points at equivalent development and funding stages.
